lines.english: Over 70 years into the Space Era, events shook mankind's fate.
"MU" suddenly appeared over Tokyo from another world, and the
Earth Federation Forces attacked. All-out war seemed certain, but
MU formed a mysterious sphere around Tokyo Bay and shut itself
in.
Soon after, a huge meteorite struck the South Pole. Mankind
suffered terribly in the disaster later called the "Second Impact", and
the Earth Sphere fell into chaos.
The Earth Sphere survived the great wars, the "One Year War" and
the "Lizard War" and seemed ready for peace at last, but the
"Gryps Conflict" and the "Devil Gundam Incident" broke out almost
at once.
On top of that, the Baam, aliens seeking to settle on Earth,
launched a war of invasion. On the ground, the "Mycenae Empire",
the "Demon Empire" and the "Dinosaur Empire" began their attacks.
The Earth Sphere faced an unprecedented crisis, but the Federation,
the AEUG, the super robots, the Nadesico B and the new Shuffle
Alliance drove back every enemy force.
Peace was made with the Baam, and even the "Neo Zeon" army,
active since the end of the Gryps Conflict, was defeated. Yet the
fires of war still did not die out.
The Giganos Empire on the Moon declared war; mysterious
enemies called "Angels" attacked; unidentified flying objects kept
appearing; and shadows flickered behind the Hisago Plan...
Now mankind was about to take its first step toward the end...
And so the battles of the Nahel Argama, the Federation's
independent strike force, and the Nadesico C came to an end.
Every organization hostile to the Earth Federation Forces was
destroyed, and peace came to mankind, if only for a while.
Special agencies like NERV, GEAR and TERRA were dismantled,
and parts of them were absorbed into the Federation forces.
The Last Guardian was all but dissolved. Masato and Miku left
Zeorymer with Oki, who had joined the military, and now live
quietly in a small, remote village.
Kazuya Ryuzaki and Erika have begun settling Mars again, and are
working hard to secure new homes for the Baam.
Duke Fleed, having defeated the Vegan Empire, said farewell to
the people of Earth and returned to Planet Fleed with Grace Maria
Fleed to rebuild it.
Rom Stol and his Machine Robo legion, too, saw peace come to
Earth and then went home to the planet Chronos.
Domon Kasshu and the other Gundam Fighters set off on training
journeys for the Gundam Fight soon to come.
With the war over, some stayed in the military and some left it for
a new world. Each of them set out on a new path of their own.
And then, #男愛称 and #女愛称...
